limitations: Debug test binaries, same pinned toolchain, no compilation concurrent with measured cases. Old then new sequentially, three repetitions.
Direct admitted batches do not simulate provider arrival cadence or UI frame/input/cancel latency.
Source identity hashes, test inventory and distinct program hashes were checked; no shared-target stale binary used.
Each paired complete logical transcript digest matches; identifiers, types, roles and content included, volatile envelope timestamps excluded.
First page/body values are first reads on reopened stores with warm OS cache; three samples do not establish a robust p95. All samples retained.
New reader schema-readiness initialization was added after this frozen candidate. These results do not validate that later change.
No historical compression, full VACUUM, widened confirmation window or weakened FULL synchronization.
